sentences.text: Trollhunters is an American computer-animated fantasy television series created for Netflix by Guillermo del Toro and produced by DreamWorks Animation and Double Dare You .	Guillermo del Toro	Guillermo del Toro	Netflix	Netflix	DreamWorks Animation	DreamWorks Animation	fantasy	fantasy
The first two episodes of the series premiered on October 8 , 2016 , at the New York Comic Con .	New York Comic Con	New York Comic Con
It was released worldwide on Netflix on December 23 , 2016 .	Netflix	Netflix

The series was nominated for four Annie Awards in 2017 , winning three in the categories of Outstanding Achievement in Character Animation , Character Design , and Storyboarding in an Animated Television/Broadcast Production .	Annie Awards	Annie Awards	2017	44th Annie Awards
On February 9 , 2017 , Netflix renewed the series for a second season of thirteen episodes , which is set to be released later in 2017 .	Netflix	Netflix	2017	44th Annie Awards
It will be adapted into a comic book by Marc Guggenheim and Richard Hamilton .	Marc Guggenheim	Marc Guggenheim
